facts.text: Rocco Forte House is a 19th century Milanese palazzo on Via Manzoni, on the corner of Via della Spiga.
facts.excerpt: Rocco Forte House in Milan is an exquisite 19th century Milanese palazzo located on Via Manzoni, on the corner of Via della Spiga

facts.text: The house is in the Quadrilatero della Moda, Milan's fashion neighbourhood.
facts.excerpt: in the heart of the city’s most fashionable neighbourhood, Quadrilatero della Moda

facts.text: The interiors were designed by Paolo Moschino Ltd in collaboration with Olga Polizzi, Director of Design at Rocco Forte Hotels.
facts.excerpt: Brought to life by award-winning design company, Paolo Moschino Ltd in collaboration with Olga Polizzi, Director of Design at Rocco Forte Hotels

facts.text: Original design details such as mouldings, frescoes and marble floors have been kept alongside modern comforts.
facts.excerpt: design details such as mouldings, frescoes and marble floors have been interlaced with modern luxury

facts.text: Each apartment has a sitting room, dining room, fully equipped kitchen and one or two bedrooms.
facts.excerpt: Each charming apartment offers spacious living quarters including a sitting room, dining room, fully equipped kitchen, and either one or two bedrooms.

facts.text: Two apartments on the third floor can interconnect to form a three-bedroom space for larger groups and families.
facts.excerpt: For larger groups and families, two apartments on the third floor can interconnect to form a three-bedroom space.

facts.text: Downstairs there is a traditional courtyard with a seating area filled with plants, open to all guests.
facts.excerpt: a traditional courtyard, a tranquil seating area filled with plants, available for all guests to enjoy

facts.text: There is a sub-level gym open 24/7.
facts.excerpt: the sub-level gym is open 24/7

facts.text: A dedicated House Concierge handles housekeeping, grocery shopping, tours and reservations.
facts.excerpt: Your dedicated House Concierge is always on hand to make your stay even more memorable. From housekeeping and grocery shopping, to arranging tours and making reservations, every detail is taken care of.

facts.text: A personal butler, private chef or event planning service is available on request.
facts.excerpt: a personal butler, private chef, or even event planning service for a special occasion, are also available on request

facts.text: The Brera apartments have original ceiling frescoes, restored.
facts.excerpt: with original frescoes, lovingly restored to their former glory, adorning the ceilings

facts.text: In the Tortona two-bedroom apartment a green lacquered wall runs through the sitting room, dining area and kitchen.
facts.excerpt: A striking green lacquered wall extends through the sitting room, dining area and fully equipped kitchen

facts.text: Tortona apartments have views of the Duomo and the city.
facts.excerpt: View:  Duomo and City

facts.text: Breakfast delivered to the apartment is available at a supplementary charge.
facts.excerpt: Breakfast delivered to your apartment

facts.text: Small pets under 6kg are welcome, with pet amenities at a supplementary charge.
facts.excerpt: Amenities for your pet (we welcome small pets under 6kg)

facts.text: A nanny service is available at a supplementary charge.
facts.excerpt: Nanny service

facts.text: A welcome hamper of Italian specialties is given on arrival for stays of at least 7 nights.
facts.excerpt: Welcome hamper on arrival with a selection of Italian specialties (for a minimum stay of 7 nights)

facts.text: The house is moments from Teatro alla Scala and Palazzo Orsini.
facts.excerpt: Moments from some of the city’s most notable sights, including Teatro alla Scala and Palazzo Orsini

facts.text: Bathrooms have skincare products by Irene Forte.
facts.excerpt: Luxurious skincare products by Irene Forte

facts.text: Daily housekeeping is included.
facts.excerpt: Daily housekeeping

facts.text: The house claims to offer unrivalled privacy, comfort and style.
facts.excerpt: Rocco Forte House offers guests unrivalled privacy, comfort and style
